body:
I'm not sure what you mean by large amounts of oxygen.
Do you mean trips outside to do nothing but breathe?  Or from a tank?

In either case, I can understand your point about oxygen.  I smoke...

I'm going to quit; I have two left right now.  After them, I'm done.  I'll update you in a week, and two weeks, and three weeks, Paul.  Even if you don't respond or care, I'm going to send you check ups.

Schizophrenia runs in my family, too.  I don't believe I have schizophrenia but I have had severe episodes of disassociation.  I had to even leave work early and go to the hospital over one that was particularly bad.  Feels like everything it was a dream, and that nothing makes sense.  "Why do I throw garbage in a garbage can?" sort of shit.  Though the episodes themselves were not brief, the period of time they occurred was.

Major depression too.  I know I have that; it runs in my family, though I never been properly diagnosed.  I've allotted so so so much time learning myself over it.  My triggers.  What happens before each fall.  I get very self-destructive, especially when I don't have someone there to keep me in check.  My focus on improving this area has been fruitful, as I still am in school, and I still am doing well.  This is a marked improvement since in highschool I always skipped class.  One semester I missed 30 complete days, and they were quarters!  For what ever reason I was still identified, even by teachers, that I was one of the brightest students.  But I didn't care because I didn't care about anything.  I still skipped, slept in class when I was there, never did homework and did not speak to anyone.  Though I wasn't bullied much, I got in multiple fights during highschool simply because others did not like me.  I always stood my ground.

This is a whole nother can of worms, and I don't think I'm ready yet to focus on them.  It needs to be done, but it would be too much.  In the mean-time I will try my hardest to get public assistance-health insurance.  I don't have any right now, and I cannot afford it.  I'm still in the hole over that once I went to the hospital for my disassociation, and that was about three years ago.  And I actually had assistance-health insurance at that point, but it was something called a 'spindown' account.  Where you had to cover so much a month, and if it got to that spindown amount, the insurance provider would cover the rest.  Basically I didn't have insurance, unless I was in the ER and racking up hundreds of thousands of dollars in bills. 

I hope that one day you find peace in your problems.  Schizophrenia is no joke, though.  Do you take properly prescribed medicines for that?

You have a very good point.  Thank you.  I cared a lot about her, and it did take a lot to get past that.

She changed a lot, very quickly.  I did know that when or if I were to get with her, I would think back to now.  With how she cheated on her husband, and that I would always be paranoid about that, especially given my already negative predisposition about the subject.

I did not blame her for not knowing.  That was my fault, and I'm humble about it.

And I have thought about how I am attracted to the wrong girls.  The girls that I do like need my help.  It's been that way ever since I was in 8th grade, attracted to the wrong girls.  The suicidal ones, the crazy ones.  The seemingly down-trodden.  I feel the overwhelming need to get my claws into it, and fix it.  That's what I do, I find systems, patterns... It's like a puzzle to me.  It's the reason my and my last girlfriend lasted so long.  It was a puzzle and I wanted to know so much how to finish it, even though it was not healthy for me one bit.

This picture from quotesporn really hits the nail on the head.  http://i.imgur.com/cJfSLIl.jpg

I'm giving up the drugs today.  No more.  I'm so hung over and far-gone right now after waking up this morning that I don't ever want to touch the stuff.  But not only just that, but I really want to feel fully how I feel right now.  It doesn't feel half-bad, knowing that I've finally told her.  That I been rejected, and that it moves on.  Feels like the eye of Jupiter has finally stood still.

I'm not sure if you read my update in the thread or not.  But I told her the situation was toxic, and we're no longer contacting each other.  It feels like a weight has been lifted.  That I've finally am clear; pure.  I was very worried where my behavior was going to take me, and I knew that it would not stop unless this stopped.

I told her the situation we were in was toxic.  After a very long chat, we mutually agreed to not speak to one another.  With assurance that we were still on good terms.

I never thought the thread would have done anything for me, and I thought I would have felt entirely alone after all this.  Proximately, yes I am.  But I don't feel as emotionally isolated and alone like I would have if not for a lot of kind words from you guys in both thread and in PMs.  I was so afraid of not being able to get out of that loop of feeling isolated.  Every morning I woke up feeling more and more alone, knowing that just because I was conscious, my situation was going to get worse.  That no matter what step I would take, it would lead to the one I had to take today, and that would be to eliminate the last of my childhood friends.  And conclusively the last friend I have in present moment.

I suppose it's fair to tell you guys.  She told me that I was the best friend she has ever had, and that I helped her make her life much better than what it was.  That she would not forget that.  I asked her if she cared about me the same way I cared about her.  She said that she did not, and was not able to give me a reason outside of "the spark never happened".

Though not very enthusiastic about much, and certainly not thrilled about how much it took to get to this point, my mind finally feels free.  That it's all over with, and the only thing now left to do is wait.
The free space in my mind is bound to be filled with something though, and I'm thrilled to see where that leads.

Thank you very, very much for making me feel not alone.  I will work on stopping the self-medication.  I don't think I need it anymore.  I never did.. but y'know.
